experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: Laser remelting at a scan speed of 25 mm/s, heat input 28.0 J/mm in Ar shielding

Experiments.Notes: LR1. Laser scan speed: 25 mm/s. Laser heat input: 28.0 J/mm. Elastic modulus and microhardness values reported are those of the beads. The values for the coating are also included, 213 ± 11 GPa and 7.58 ± 0.27 GPa resp.. unsure of difference between coating and bead.
